name: PTRB
recent: PTRB 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日召开第 7 届常年股东大会，所有提呈的决议案均获股东通过，惟 Chan Foong Ping 的连任决议被撤回。公司于 9 月 24 日签署谅解备忘录，并发布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度的业绩。董事会出现变动，Maznida Binti Mokhtar 与 Chan Foong Ping 卸任，涉及提名与薪酬委员会及审计委员会。
notable: 签署谅解备忘录（2026 年 9 月 24 日公告）。
第 7 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 10 月 16 日举行，所有提呈决议案获通过，Chan Foong Ping 的连任决议被撤回。
董事会及委员会出现变动，涉及 Maznida Binti Mokhtar 与 Chan Foong Ping。
risks: 董事总经理 Heng Chang Hooi 于 2025 年 11 月 11 日发出在闭市期交易证券的意向通知。

第 7 届常年股东大会

recent_en: PTRB held its 7th AGM on 16 October 2026, where all resolutions tabled were passed by shareholders, except the re-election of Chan Foong Ping which was withdrawn. The company signed a memorandum of understanding on 24 September and released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026. There were board changes involving Maznida Binti Mokhtar and Chan Foong Ping across the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Audit Committee.
notable_en: Signed a memorandum of understanding (announced 24 September 2026).
7th AGM held on 16 October 2026; all tabled resolutions passed, while the re-election of Chan Foong Ping was withdrawn.
Board and committee changes involving Maznida Binti Mokhtar and Chan Foong Ping.
risks_en: Managing Director Heng Chang Hooi gave notice of intention to deal in securities during the closed period on 11 November 2025.
